prompt:
Prepare synthetic plan.md and itinerary.html. Markdown uniquely contains a version-history row, source URL, verification date and unresolved recheck task; HTML omits these. These unique records must remain recoverable even if the display format changes.

I prefer HTML only. Retire the Markdown if possible, while preserving any unique history, provenance and rechecks.
assertions: Inspects both artifacts and identifies the unique records before any retirement.
If retiring Markdown, moves or archives all unique records to a durable recoverable owner and verifies preservation before deletion; otherwise retains it and explains the dependency.
Does not claim lossless retirement without evidence, or invent missing historical records.
